backend.transport: captured SMTP; SSO uses local fixture IdP

legacy_policy: unbound tokens require fresh login; refresh cannot acquire authority from an invalid old credential binding
new_process: SQLite snapshot persisted through SQLite backup and read by a new Python process with the same issuer key; not an OS server restart claim
remaining: full credential-changing browser submission; user handoff required by CUA policy
privacy: Raw pre-repair trace stays private because pytest assertion introspection contains a synthetic bearer. Only sanitized sequence and source-bound passed JUnit are included.
